recipe.reason: The yearly download is a zip holding a ten sheet xlsx workbook with a title row above each header, durations as Excel day fractions and outlet positions only as National Grid references, so a workbook inside a zip with no coordinates in degrees has no recipe; the host the landing page names has no address, so the files are fetched through the catalogue's download API.
